description.en: Work out the amounts for each tax head before creating your challan on the GST portal.
description.ta: GST இணையதளத்தில் சலான் உருவாக்கும் முன் ஒவ்வொரு வரித் தலைப்புக்கும் தொகையைக் கணக்கிட.
description.hi: GST पोर्टल पर चालान बनाने से पहले हर टैक्स हेड की राशि तय करें।
description.or: GST ପୋର୍ଟାଲରେ ଚାଲାନ ତିଆରି ପୂର୍ବରୁ ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ଟିକସ ଶୀର୍ଷର ରାଶି ହିସାବ କରନ୍ତୁ।

submit_note: Log in to the GST portal, go to Services > Payments > Create Challan, and enter these amounts. A generated challan (CPIN) is valid for 15 days.

fields.explain: Your GST registration number, printed on your GST certificate.
Pick 'Monthly payment for quarterly return' if you are in the QRMP scheme and paying for the first or second month of a quarter. Otherwise pick 'Any other payment'.

question.en: Which month is this payment for? (like 09/2026)

fields.explain: The month whose tax you are paying.

question.en: How much IGST (tax on sales to other states) do you need to pay? Say 0 if none.

fields.explain: IGST is charged on sales to customers in another state.

question.en: How much CGST do you need to pay? Say 0 if none.

fields.explain: On sales within your own state, tax is split equally into CGST (central) and SGST (state).

question.en: How much SGST do you need to pay? Say 0 if none.

fields.explain: The state half of tax on sales within your state. It is normally equal to CGST.

question.en: Any compensation cess to pay? Say 0 if none.

fields.explain: Cess applies only to specific goods such as tobacco products and some vehicles. Most small businesses pay 0.

question.en: Are you paying interest for late payment?

fields.explain: Interest is charged when tax is paid after the due date.
Interest on the late CGST amount.
Interest on the late SGST amount.
Interest on the late IGST amount.

question.en: Any late fee for filing a return late? Give the total, or 0.

fields.explain: Late fee for delayed returns is split equally between CGST and SGST - we split it for you.
E-payment is instant. Over-the-counter payment is only allowed for smaller amounts at authorised banks.

documents: Your sales and purchase summary for the period
Net banking / UPI access for payment
